name: Haglund Deformity
definition: Prominent posterosuperior calcaneal morphology that can mechanically irritate footwear and contribute to retrocalcaneal bursitis or insertional Achilles symptoms.

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing radiographs define bony prominence; MRI is selective for tendon disease.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Surgery is reserved for persistent symptoms with clearly correlated structural irritation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada/Asthi-vriddhi phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Prominent posterosuperior calcaneal morphology that can mechanically irritate footwear and contribute to retrocalcaneal bursitis or insertional Achilles symptoms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
